Recruiter

Overview

The recruiter promises Kir work and supplies papers for travel through a portal to Suslanger. The apparent opportunity becomes the opening trap of the campaign: Kir arrives as a stranger whom the imperial authorities enslave. [1, 2]

Escape from Jigran

Kir, whose full name is Kir-A-Chit-La, is a young Joon enslaved under Firez on Jigran. He escapes the castle, leaving his family behind, and hopes to return with help. Outside the castle, a recruiter mistakes him for someone expected at the camp. Kir conceals his identity and accepts travel papers for work on Suslanger. The apparent opening to freedom instead delivers him to imperial authorities. Hartweik dismisses his papers, treats him as a slave and considers reporting the red-skinned stranger for a reward. [1, 2, 3, 4]
